description: Searches the study material: Bible stories (e.g. "prodigal son"), themes (e.g. "forgiveness"), prophecies and their fulfilment, gospel parallels and timeline events. Returns ids for get_topic.

language.description: Language for names, notes and study content, and for the links to bible.flogvit.com: en (English), nb (Norwegian Bokmål), nn (Norwegian Nynorsk), sv (Swedish), fr (French), es (Spanish), fi (Finnish), de (German). Content missing in a language falls back to English. Default: en.

query.description: Words to look for in titles and descriptions, at least 2 characters, e.g. "prodigal son", "forgiveness", "exodus".

name: search_topics
title: Find stories, themes and prophecies
